O.content: The red marker at each successive labeled year from 2017 through 2020 is higher on the page than the preceding marker.

B.text: If the displayed 2017-2020 rising segment is assumed to be representative of the unshown 2013-2016 portion, then the visible multi-year rise may be treated as evidence for sustained growth follow-up. This conclusion depends on the unverified representativeness assumption.
B.conditions: Requires treating the unshown 2013-2016 data as consistent with the displayed rise; no supplied chart evidence establishes that assumption.

O.content: The red marker at each successive labeled year from 2017 through 2020 is higher on the page than the preceding marker.
The subtitle reads "Reported window shown in the dashboard summary."

B.text: If the line series represents yearly respiratory clinic visits in the displayed years and higher vertical position encodes more visits, successive higher points from 2017 through 2020 indicate a recent upward pattern. If the task requires an end-to-end 2013-2020 determination but the chart displays only 2017-2020, sustained growth over the full window cannot be verified; under that limitation, the recent-upward-shift monitoring option is the non-overclaiming fit.
B.conditions: Applies only if the plotted series is the respiratory clinic visit series and the omitted 2013-2016 period is not available elsewhere in the supplied evidence.
